lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Since needs have plus a past form.
Have! I have worked here since May.

data.why: Since needs have plus a past form.

native.tip: Com “since” usamos o present perfect: “I have lived”, não “I live”.

native.comment: Resposta: “have”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I live here since”?
en.tip: With “since” we use the present perfect: “I have lived”, not “I live”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I live here since 2020.”. The right way is “I have lived here since 2020.”. Portuguese uses the present, but English needs another tense. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
